title: Add and remove projects from every TUI view

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner report 2026-10-27 (on c0848ab): with one project registered, + does nothing, so more projects cannot be added from the TUI. It is by design today: the add key is bound as "+ add project (Welcome)" (internal/tui/keys.go:64) and handled only in welcomeKey (internal/tui/welcome.go:86), which is reached only when no project is registered (internal/tui/model.go:461-466). docs/dashboard.md:52-53 says the add key works only on Welcome in this slice (S96).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/tui/model.go`, `internal/tui/welcome.go`, `internal/tui/keys.go`: global add/remove keys, reused add field, discovery replies, hint priorities and help bindings.
- `internal/tui/projects.go`: named removal confirmation, dim explanation, daemon removal result and read-only history.
- `internal/tui/view.go`: add/remove bodies and help text.
- `internal/tui/daemon.go`, `internal/tui/live.go`: Live gains ProjectsRemove and the daemon adapter calls Client.RemoveProject.
- `internal/tui/welcome_test.go`, `internal/tui/keymap_test.go`, `internal/tui/live_test.go`: add/remove behavior, confirmations, refusals, help, hints and fakes.
- `docs/dashboard.md`, `testdata/golden/`: project management flow, hint/help changes and golden views.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Tests first. + opens the path field outside Welcome; esc cancels back to the view; the hint and help list it. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/tui ./internal/cli; goldens; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
